title: What is Profound? Ex-Swiggy, Zomato executives partner for AI hiring platform startup
description: Former Swiggy and Zomato executives have soft-launched Profound, an AI startup that replaces traditional resumes with personalized, voice-activated AI representatives to offer intelligent matchmaking for career opportunities and recruitment. The platform focuses on understanding individual professional profiles beyond keywords, enabling better matches between candidates and employers. Profound has raised $1.5 million in seed funding and is currently in early access, with plans for a broader launch later this year.
content:
Former vice-president of Swiggy, Anuj Rath and ex-Chief Technology Officer at Zomato, Prashant Parashar, have soft-launched an Artificial Intelligence startup called Profound.

title: Zomato And Blinkit facilitate ₹18 Crores of Income Tax refunds by enabling over 100,000 Delivery Partners across 905 cities to file their ITR
description: New Delhi [India], August 4: Eternal companies, Zomato and Blinkit have collectively facilitated income tax return (ITR) filing for more than 100,000 delivery partners so far this year, spanning 905 cities across the country. The filing deadline for gig workers is still a month away, on 31 August 2026.
